assets.prompt: Create a dark fantasy game CHARACTER DESIGN LINEUP: exactly four full-body characters in four evenly spaced columns on a genuinely transparent background, generous clear gutters, no labels or text, no framing or scenery. Attached game title image is a COLOR AND MOOD REFERENCE ONLY. Restrained hand-inked graphic novel concept art with broad readable shapes, matte materials, deliberate visible brush texture, limited palette black #09080e, charcoal #19151f, gray steel #827a8e, pale gray #d8d2dd and smoky violet #79618f. Faces and hands remain readable with subdued natural skin tones. No gold, jewelry, ornate filigree, luminous aura, particles, excessive spikes or glossy photoreal rendering. Each figure entirely inside its column, grounded neutral stance, consistent scale. LEFT TO RIGHT: 1) Male warrior, face hidden in a simple CLOSED angular dark iron helmet, weathered asymmetrical armor, one broad shoulder plate and a torn deep violet half-cloak, a heavy straight sword with a nick near its tip held low, no decorative spikes. 2) Female guardian, short reddish-brown hair with one long braid, worn gray plate over black cloth, sturdy squared shield with a distinctive missing upper corner, short sword, practical grounded stance; no princess/angel motifs. 3) Androgynous rogue, low black hood, pale simple beak mask, layered charcoal cloth, small leather poison vials, two narrow steel daggers, asymmetrical wrapped forearm, small muted green vial ONLY. 4) Female mage, short silver hair, long black coat with one folded smoky-violet collar, bare readable face, a crooked plain iron staff ending in an incomplete ring, small pale-violet stone suspended inside, practical boots, no floating symbols. Four distinct silhouettes, recognizable equipment, shared visual world. Semi-stylized proportions about six heads tall, not chibi or anime. Keep the same strong light from upper-left on all four, neutral matte gray highlights. No background checkerboard. This is the first design proposal for Eterno Retorno; do not copy the title lettering.

Restyle this four-character lineup as authentic HAND-DRAWN SKETCHBOOK CONCEPT ART in graphite, charcoal and muted colored pencil. Preserve exactly the same FOUR characters, left-to-right order, identities, costumes, weapons, scale, neutral full-body stance and generous separation. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, no paper rectangle, no checkerboard, no labels. Critical artistic treatment: visible broken pencil contours with varied pressure, loose searching construction strokes at armor edges, directional graphite hatching and crossed shading, colored pencil violet strokes over gray base, subtle irregular hand coloring, broad simplified values, some unfinished cloth edges. It should look like a skilled artist's exploratory costume sketches from a personal notebook, not polished rendered video-game key art, not smooth digital painting, not photoreal, not inked comic, not anime. Subdued palette charcoal black, cold gray and smoky VIOLET; small natural skin and reddish brown hair and one muted green poison vial retained. Preserve readable faces/helmet/beak, matte worn metal and asymmetry. Reduce fine armor surface texture and decorative detail significantly. NO luminous effects, no auras, no golden trim, no extra ornaments. All hands and weapons complete inside image, all FOUR full bodies visible. Consistent top-left light. The hand sketch character silhouettes are isolated in alpha so they can be placed on a dark gray notebook UI. Large landscape image.

A REAL SKETCHBOOK PAGE, landscape format, photographed flat-on without photographic lighting or perspective. Entire background is visible lightly worn cool-gray drawing PAPER, subtle fibers, eraser smudges and a few faint exploratory pencil marks. Exactly FOUR loosely drawn full-body dark fantasy adventurer costume studies, separated in four columns. These are unfinished concept sketches drawn BY HAND using graphite, charcoal and a little muted violet colored pencil: scratchy searching lines, double/triple contours, visible gesture and construction lines, rough fast cross-hatching, untouched paper gaps in clothes, loosely blocked shadows, abbreviated hands and boot details but anatomically coherent. Only about 40 percent of each figure is shaded, the rest suggested by light pencil linework and gray paper. NO finely rendered metal surface, no polished inked outline, no 3D form rendering, no photographic textures, no cinematic illustration, no pixel art. Think a working artist's exploratory character notebook, not completed videogame marketing art. Small human irregularities in line weight, asymmetrical hems, traces of erased construction. Restrained BLACK GRAPHITE, gray paper, charcoal shadows and VIOLET pencil accents. No labels, no text or symbols pretending to be handwriting. Left to right: male warrior with closed plain angular iron helmet, one broad shoulder guard, torn violet half-cloak, worn straight sword; female guardian with reddish-brown braid, plain worn plate, black-violet cloth, squared shield missing one top corner and short sword; hooded rogue with simple pale beak mask, wrapped arm, layered black cloth, two daggers and tiny muted-green vial; female mage with short silver hair, long dark coat with folded violet collar and plain crooked staff with an open ring. All four complete full bodies, same approximate height, neutral slightly imperfect poses, lots of gray-paper space around and between them. Faces/helmet/beak should be recognizable in just a few confident strokes. Absolutely prioritize loose authentic PENCIL DRAWING, sketchbook incompleteness and paper surface over detail or realism. This is a new concept direction for Eterno Retorno.

Edit this exact sketchbook page. KEEP the four characters, positions, costumes, visible gray paper, loose graphite construction lines, rough irregular colored-pencil marks, and unfinished hand-drawn concept-art style. Only improve the contrast and depth of color of the CHARACTERS: make the deepest cloth/shadow areas confidently charcoal-black with dense visible pencil strokes, bring out medium-gray steel planes and clear light-gray edge accents, give violet cloth substantially richer deeper smoky purple colored-pencil pigment, and make red-brown hair and natural skin a little more visible. The paper stays mid-light gray, relatively calm, so silhouettes stand out. Use approximately 30 percent stronger character contrast and noticeably stronger violet pigment without neon colors. Keep a tiny readable green poison vial. Preserve sketched broken edges, eraser traces and areas of bare paper inside figures; do NOT turn it into a polished digital render, photoreal, ink comic or vector. No new ornaments, no shiny magical particles, no labels, no extra figures. Output a full landscape sketchbook page with all four complete full-body figures.
